metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia appear greener on February 7, 2021 as compared to the same region on January 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about comparing greenness around Windhoek, Namibia between two specific dates: - February 7, 2021 - January 29, 2020 To answer this, I need to: 1. Define the geometry around Windhoek, Namibia 2. Get satellite imagery for both dates (I'll use Sentinel-2 for good resolution) 3. Calculate NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) to measure greenness 4. Compare the mean NDVI values between the two dates 5. Handle potential data issues (no images, cloud cover, etc.) For NDVI: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) For Sentinel-2: B8 (NIR) and B4 (Red) I'll use a point geometry with a buffer around Windhoek and check for cloud-free imagery on the specific dates. If no data is available, I'll try to recover by using nearby dates or alternative collections. Let me structure the code: - Define Windhoek geometry with buffer - Get Sentinel-2 imagery for both exact dates - Apply cloud masking - Calculate NDVI - Compute mean NDVI for each date - Compare and determine answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.0832, -22.5700]); // Windhoek coordinates const roi = windhoek.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Windhoek const date2020 = '2020-01-29'; const date2021 = '2021-02-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function getS2Image(date) { const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); // Cloud masking function function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } collection = collection.map(maskS2clouds); if (collection.size().getInfo() > 0) { return collection.median().clip(roi); } return null; } // 3. Get images for both dates const img2020 = getS2Image(date2020); const img2021 = getS2Image(date2021); // Check if collections are empty if (!img2020 || !img2021) { console.log("2020 Images: 0"); console.log("2021 Images: 0"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Calculate NDVI for both images function calculateNDVI(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } const ndvi2020 = calculateNDVI(img2020); const ndvi2021 = calculateNDVI(img2021); // 5. Compute statistics const stats2020 = ndvi2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2020 = stats2020.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2020 = stats2020.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const mean2021 = stats2021.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2021 = stats2021.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); // 6. Validation checks console.log(`2020-01-29: Mean NDVI ${mean2020?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2020}`); console.log(`2021-02-07: Mean NDVI ${mean2021?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2021}`); if (count2020 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean2020 === null || mean2021 === null || isNaN(mean2020) || isNaN(mean2021) || mean2020 > 1 || mean2020 < -1 || mean2021 > 1 || mean2021 < -1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Final comparison if (mean2021 > mean2020) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
